primary_goal: Drive product purchase (Add to Cart / Buy Now) for the robot vacuum cleaner.

friction_points.issue: The buy box on the right is obscured by a large white vertical overlay layout glitch, hiding the primary call-to-action buttons.
friction_points.evidence: A white container overlays the right side of the screen, cutting off the yellow/orange 'Add to Basket' / 'Buy Now' buttons.

friction_points.issue: Prices are shown in GBP on amazon.de with delivery set to the UK, creating currency calculation friction for German market users.
friction_points.evidence: Top header shows 'Deliver to United Kingdom', main price shows 'GBP 292.05' on the .de domain.

friction_points.issue: Inconsistent mixing of English and German language elements across the product title, features, and trust badges.
friction_points.evidence: Title is in English ('DREAME L10s Ultra Gen 3...'), subtitle below is German ('Ausfahrbare Seitenbürste & Wischmopp...'), and trust badge reads 'Elektrogeräte Rücknahme'.

friction_points.issue: Cluttered variant box with confusing micro-copy below style options.
friction_points.evidence: Button below style choices reads 'See 1 options with no featured offers', adding visual noise.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we fix the visual rendering overlay bug on the buy box, then CTA click rate will increase because users can clearly see and click the purchase buttons.
hypotheses.change: Remove the overlapping white layout container so the main buy box and CTA buttons are fully visible.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we automatically match currency (EUR) and language context to the local market default on Amazon.de, then conversion rate will improve because cross-border pricing friction will be eliminated.
hypotheses.change: Default display currency to EUR and synchronize language throughout all product sections.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we display recognized German payment badges (Klarna, PayPal, Invoice) and clear return details directly near the price, then checkout start rate will improve because trust and buyer security will increase.
hypotheses.change: Add local payment and clear return guarantee icons directly below the main price.

quick_wins: Fix right-side sidebar rendering issue covering the primary CTA buttons.
Fix string copy grammar in variant selector ('See 1 option' instead of 'See 1 options').
Standardize product feature language so title and bullet points match.
uncertainties: Whether the right-side overlay issue is caused by a user browser extension/adblocker or an actual CSS rendering bug on the live page.
The user's actual geo-location vs. selected delivery destination (UK).
